tournament.name: MTG SEA Championship Final Season 2 Round 3

decks.notes: This Golgari Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruptive spells. The deck includes powerful cards like Liliana of the Veil, Archfiend of the Dross, and Glissa Sunslayer, while also utilizing removal spells like Go for the Throat and Cut Down to control the opponent's board. With a mix of creature power and disruption, this deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain board advantage throughout the game to secure a quick victory.

This deck focuses on aggression and taking advantage of the opponent's weaknesses by controlling the board with a mix of creatures and spells. The deck includes a variety of evasion abilities, disruptive cards, and a few powerful finishers to quickly overwhelm the opponent. By combining aggressive creatures like Spyglass Siren and Faerie Mastermind with control elements like Go for the Throat and Liliana of the Veil, the deck aims to apply constant pressure and force the opponent into making unfavorable trades. The key strategy is to maintain a balance between aggression and disruption to secure victory.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly building a wide board of creatures and overwhelming the opponent with aggression. The key strategy is to efficiently flood the board with low-cost creatures like Novice Inspector and Knight-Errant of Eos, supported by resilient threats like Warden of the Inner Sky and Voldaren Epicure. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Imodane's Recruiter and Resolute Reinforcements to apply pressure and maintain board control. With a mix of efficient creatures and powerful spells, this deck aims to close out games quickly through combat damage.

This UW Control deck focuses on card advantage, disruption, and controlling the board through counterspells and removal. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent by utilizing cards like Tishana's Tidebinder, Memory Deluge, and Deduce to draw cards and maintain control. It also disrupts the opponent's strategy with cards like Get Lost and March of Otherworldly Light. The deck utilizes a variety of lands to fix mana and provide utility, while also including win conditions like The Wandering Emperor and Jace, the Perfected Mind to close out the game.

This deck focuses on playing aggressively with a mix of creatures, spells, and lands that work together to put pressure on the opponent quickly. The key strategy involves using powerful creatures like Slogurk, the Overslime and Rona, Herald of Invasion alongside removal spells like Go for the Throat to control the board and deal damage efficiently. The deck also includes support cards like Relic of Legends and Xander's Lounge to help maintain card advantage and support the aggressive game plan. Additionally, the mana base is carefully constructed to ensure smooth and consistent gameplay.

This deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures and tactics to overwhelm the opponent quickly. By using a combination of efficient creatures like Crawling Chorus and Slaughter Singer, alongside powerful spells like March of Swirling Mist and Serum Snare, the deck aims to create a fast and relentless attacking strategy. The inclusion of cards like Skrelv's Hive and Venerated Rotpreist also allows for synergies that can further enhance the deck's overall aggro strategy. The mana base is designed to support the deck's aggressive game plan while also providing flexibility in color requirements.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by using various removal spells and counterspells to disrupt your opponent's strategy. The deck also includes card draw and recursion effects to ensure you have the resources you need to outlast your opponent. With a mix of efficient removal, counterspells, and card advantage, the deck aims to control the game until you can take over with powerful threats like Aclazotz, Deepest Betrayal and Jace, the Perfected Mind.

The main idea of this deck is to maintain control of the game by disrupting the opponent's strategy, countering their spells, and drawing cards to outvalue them in the late game. It focuses on using a variety of spells to control the board state and prevent the opponent from executing their game plan effectively. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Hullbreaker Horror and Jace, the Perfected Mind to close out the game once the opponent has been sufficiently controlled and outpaced.

The deck focuses on utilizing control elements to manage the board and opponent's resources effectively. By controlling the game state and gradually building up resources, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory. Additionally, it features cards that provide card advantage and protection to maintain its position in the game. This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays and combat tricks to quickly overwhelm opponents. The deck includes low-cost creatures like Novice Inspector and Warden of the Inner Sky to establish early board presence, while also utilizing powerful spells like Resolute Reinforcements and Destroy Evil to push through for damage. The inclusion of cards like Gleeful Demolition and Case of the Gateway Express provides additional removal and reach, giving the deck multiple avenues to close out games swiftly. With a mix of efficient creatures and versatile spells, this deck aims to win through early aggression and resource denial.

This Golgari Aggro deck focuses on controlling the board and disrupting the opponent's strategy with discard spells like Duress and removal spells like Go for the Throat. It also utilizes powerful creatures like Glissa Sunslayer and Graveyard Trespasser to apply pressure and close out the game quickly. The deck includes a mix of powerful planeswalkers like Liliana of the Veil and creatures like Mosswood Dreadknight to outvalue the opponent and maintain board presence. Additionally, the deck includes utility lands like Cavern of Souls and Boseiju, Who Endures to ensure its threats are difficult to deal with.

This Golgari Aggro deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures and controlling the board with removal spells. The deck utilizes a mix of powerful creatures like Glissa Sunslayer and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, along with removal spells like Go for the Throat and Cut Down to maintain board dominance. Additionally, the deck includes disruption cards like Duress to disrupt the opponent's hand and Liliana of the Veil to control the battlefield. The mana base is built to support the deck's color requirements and ensure consistent plays throughout the game. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells.

This Orzhov Control deck focuses on managing the opponent's resources while building up your own advantage through card advantage and removal spells. The strategy involves disrupting the opponent's game plan with removal spells like Go for the Throat and Sheoldred's Edict, while gaining card advantage with Phyrexian Arena and Liliana of the Veil. The deck also utilizes creatures like Doorkeeper Thrull and Hunted Bonebrute to control the board. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent by grinding out incremental advantages and ultimately overwhelming them with powerful threats like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Aclazotz, Deepest Betrayal.

This UW Control deck focuses on gaining card advantage and controlling the board through powerful counterspells and removal spells. By using cards like Memory Deluge and Three Steps Ahead to draw cards and control the opponent's plays with cards like Get Lost and March of Otherworldly Light, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent and control the game until it can win with powerful finishers like The Wandering Emperor and Jace, the Perfected Mind. The deck also includes lands that can disrupt the opponent's mana base, adding another layer of control to the strategy.

The deck also includes powerful control finishers like Jace, the Perfected Mind and The Wandering Emperor to close out the game once the opponent's resources have been depleted.
